name: Potpots | 10mg Chocolate | Milk Chocolate Bites 10ct
description:
Potdots are the premiere 1mg sugar shelled edibles that allow you to control your dose to the milligram, while also being so very snackable, shareable, and microdosable. Potdots are especially recommended to those who may have been put off by edibles in the past. Milk Chocolate Potdots contain a gourmet 34% cacao chocolate blended with precisely dosed full-spectrum THC, all wrapped up in a colorful candy coating.

 

Everybody has their Potdots number – what’s yours?
